description: This file contains utility functions for working with nested Python data structures called pytrees, specifically in the context of PyTorch. It includes functions for registering custom pytree nodes, flattening, unflattening, mapping, and serializing pytrees, as well as handling key paths (though some features are not yet implemented).

classes.name: LeafSpec
classes.description: A deprecated class representing a leaf treespec, used for type checking and compatibility.

methods.name: register_pytree_node
methods.description: Registers a custom Python type as a pytree node with specified flattening and unflattening functions.

methods.name: tree_is_leaf
methods.description: Checks if a given pytree is a leaf node.

methods.name: tree_flatten
methods.description: Flattens a pytree into a list of leaves and a treespec.

methods.name: tree_unflatten
methods.description: Reconstructs a pytree from leaves and a treespec.

methods.name: tree_structure
methods.description: Returns the treespec representing the structure of a pytree.

methods.name: tree_map
methods.description: Applies a function over leaves of one or more pytrees to produce a new pytree.

methods.name: tree_iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the leaves of a pytree.

methods.name: tree_leaves
methods.description: Returns a list of all leaves in a pytree.

methods.name: treespec_dumps
methods.description: Serializes a treespec to a JSON string.

methods.name: treespec_loads
methods.description: Deserializes a treespec from a JSON string.

methods.name: treespec_pprint
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed string representation of a treespec.

methods.name: tree_flatten_with_path
methods.description: Flattens a pytree and returns key paths along with leaves (not yet implemented).

methods.name: tree_leaves_with_path
methods.description: Returns leaves with key paths (not yet implemented).

methods.name: tree_map_with_path
methods.description: Maps a function over a pytree with key paths (not yet implemented).

methods.name: keystr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a key path (not yet implemented).

methods.name: key_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an object given a key path (not yet implemented).
